status: Fixed before CODE7 results; all CODE6 target values and outcomes already known
question: Can observed replicate variation or uncertainty in the fitted single-stress span explain the CODE6 outside component?
analysis_role: Post-result sensitivity analysis, not new untouched validation or a calibrated hypothesis test
unchanged: Exact CODE6 fixed gene panels, log2(1+FPKM), duplicate-ID exclusion, equal three-pair centroid, control mean and target libraries

empirical.scenarios: All six CODE6 genotype/filter combinations; WT>=1 primary
empirical.V3: Span of three single-condition means minus CT mean
empirical.V9: Span of nine individual single-stress libraries minus CT mean
empirical.V11: V9 plus three CT residual vectors about CT mean; rank at most 11
empirical.nestedness: Verify V3 subset V9 subset V11; retain full numerical ranks without target selection
empirical.decomposition: Within V3, V9-minus-V3, V11-minus-V9, outside V11; last three gains sum exactly to CODE6 outside gain
empirical.metrics: Per-library and mean MSE/MAE for CT, fixed centroid, withinV3/V9/V11; component norm, dot product and gain; preserve negative values
empirical.disjoint_control: CODE6 singles-only diagnostic panel. For each CTk fit V3 and V9 relative to CTk, symmetrize other two distinct control references, same covariance correction. V11 prohibited because it uses held-out references.
empirical.descriptive_flag: Survives observed-cloud expansion only if outsideV11 gain positive in all three target libraries AND outsideV9 corrected margin positive in all three overlapping control splits; not a test of true biological rank

simulation.panels: Exact CODE6 FPKM>=1 main panel per genotype, no simulated refiltering
simulation.single_mean_span: Latent CT=C observed CT mean; project all seven observed nonCT mean displacements into fitted V3 and add C
simulation.joint_rank3: Top3 SVD of all seven observed nonCT mean displacements, including already-seen target; project means and add C. Require latent singles span rank3, report conditioning; stop this null if rank fails. Outcome-seen nuisance fit, not prediction.
simulation.latent_fit_diagnostics: Per-condition mean displacement from observations divided by estimated mean sampling variance; latent single rank/conditioning and negative log-mean rate. Do not clip or adapt means.
simulation.covariance: Sigma_s=(1-lambda)R_s.T R_s/(3-1)+lambda diag(sample gene variances), where R_s are three within-condition centered log-library residuals
simulation.generation: Eight independent Gaussian condition-mean errors with covariance scale^2*Sigma_s/3. No recentering simulated means. Common standardized draws across scales/nulls permitted and recorded. Deterministic scenario-index seeds, no reseeding for outcomes.
simulation.scale: Continuous log-expression Gaussian sensitivity; allow negative simulated values, no flooring. Not synthetic counts or a physical expression model. Report approximation/negative rate.
simulation.statistic: T=2*dot(Qd,Qy)/G-dot(Qd,Qd)/G, d=paircentroid-CT, y=triplemean-CT. Equals average target-library outside MSE gain.
paired_scores: refitted single span with noisy CT
fixed latent span with same noisy CT
fixed latent span with true latent CT
simulation.oracle_limit: Fixed-span/noisy-CT can be positive from shared control error. Compare paired differences to isolate basis estimation versus shared reference effects.
simulation.summaries: All draws; quantiles .025,.5,.95,.975,.99; observed-T exceedance fraction and Monte Carlo SE. These are conditional simulation summaries, NOT calibrated P-values or biological confidence intervals.
simulation.reporting_flag: At unitSD compare observedT to each of six null/covariance95th percentiles. Any non-exceedance means that assumption produces as-large T within upper simulated range, not proof of noise. Exceeding all means only beyond tested unit-noise ranges, never noise ruled out.
simulation.scope_limit: Only T on main panel is simulated. This does not calibrate disjoint-control population margins with different panels/bases. Empirical expansion is separate.

limits: n=3 RNA pools cannot identify full cross-gene covariance
empirical covariance rank<=2 per condition; diagonal mixtures are imposed alternatives
V11 is observed variation, not true biological subspace
no pure high-order interaction, causal mechanism, formal P-value or gene-level biological replication
weaker geometric interpretation does not erase CODE6 predictive performance
resources: Existing Python here; no installation or SciNet expected
amendments: Record corrections explicitly; no silent model/rank/noise-setting changes after results
